capabilities: Track how often notes are opened on desktop and mobile
Generate an analytics report with all-time and 30/90/365-day open counts
Compute trending scores from weighted 30/90/365-day windows
Log raw open events to an append-only NDJSON file
Regenerate the report from the command palette
extras: README warns that frequent writes can cause sync conflicts with Obsidian Sync, iCloud or Dropbox, and suggests raising the write debounce or disabling the NDJSON event log. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see which notes are opened most often or how note usage trends over time.
summary: Usage analytics plugin that counts how often notes are opened and generates a report with all-time, 30/90/365-day totals and trending scores.
